name: epoch_engine_ai_control_loop
summary: Evidence-gated loop for turning editor/project work into build-verified AI training and eval material without confusing the normal game/software editor with the self-iteration sandbox.

roles.teacher: optional local helper LLM used only for development-time review and curation

loop.input: active project, script, manifest, task prompt, and current roadmap intent
reviewed packet plus explicit operator request

loop.output: child-project build log and output executable evidence

loop.input: build output, runtime captures, MCP captures, eval prompts, and retained logs
loop.output: pass/fail evidence and normalized review notes

promotion_rules: Never promote raw captures directly into committed datasets.
Never treat failed builds as positive training examples unless explicitly labeled as failure-analysis data.
Never allow blind repo write-through from planner or executor output.
Never accept EpochBot saying it is working fine unless the answer cites visible tool, build, scene, packet, log, or capture evidence.
Keep self-iteration sandbox tasks separate from normal ProjectLauncher game/software editing unless the operator explicitly approves a project/editor change.
Every promoted record must be traceable to a staged packet, build log, runtime capture, MCP capture, or eval case.
Local checkpoints, local models, and caches stay under the workspace AI folders unless packaged intentionally.
next_required_hooks: scene-state diff capture for object edits
script/tool action replay against editor state
